topics.title: New Custodes Rules & Combat Patrol Box - What Players Need to Know
topics.what_is_driving_it: Major Custodes statline overhaul with new Combat Patrol box revealed, generating significant discussion around competitive viability and unit changes.
topics.relevance_note: Multiple high-engagement videos from Auspex Tactics and community debate on new rules—timely for players building or updating Custodes armies.

topics.title: Dark Angels & The Lion - New Divergent Chapter Rules Deep Dive
topics.what_is_driving_it: Major Dark Angels supplement with Primarch Lion El'Jonson receiving significant rules updates and chapter-specific mechanics.
topics.relevance_note: High-velocity content from Auspex Tactics; fans are excited about Primarch mechanics and competitive implications for one of 40K's flagship factions.
topics.gap_note: Strong demand for faction-specific deep dives showing how Divergent Chapter rules work mechanically—opportunity for cinematic breakdowns of build variety and competitive positioning.

topics.title: Kill Team Legion of the Damned - New Operatives & Competitive Meta Shift
topics.what_is_driving_it: Legion of the Damned faction return to Kill Team with new operatives and rules, generating tournament and casual interest.
topics.relevance_note: Multiple videos covering both competitive meta (tournaments) and casual experience (KiriothTV, Liminal, CritsNCoffee); Kill Team is experiencing growth momentum.
topics.gap_note: High engagement but fragmented coverage—opportunity for comprehensive Kill Team operatives showcase, team-building guides, and tournament primer content that consolidates scattered community knowledge.

topics.title: Space Marines Year 3 Release Strategy - What to Buy & Build
topics.what_is_driving_it: New Space Marine releases announced with Year 3 roadmap; community discussing product value and army-building priorities.
topics.relevance_note: Official release announcements + community anticipation; Space Marines are the largest player base—high audience appeal.
topics.gap_note: Recurring question about which kits offer best value and synergy—opportunity for cinematic product breakdowns, build guides, and cost-per-point analysis that helps new/returning players navigate the release.

topics.title: Warhammer 40K Lore Explainers - Flying Cherubs/Cherubim & Faction Deep Cuts
topics.what_is_driving_it: Community curiosity about 40K's more unusual lore elements (flying babies/cherubim) driving dedicated video content.
topics.relevance_note: Arbitor Ian's lore explainer gaining traction; shows demand for accessible, visually-driven narrative education.
topics.gap_note: High discussion/fascination with niche lore topics but limited cinematic coverage—opportunity to own faction quirk explainers with dramatic visual storytelling (animations, artwork, voiceover).

topics.title: Golden Demon Painting Showcases - How Pros Paint Miniatures at Competitive Level
topics.what_is_driving_it: Golden Demon competition results and pro painter interviews (OmegonEdge, Julien Kirszenbaum) generating interest in advanced painting techniques.
topics.relevance_note: Warhammer Community featuring pro painter interviews + community reaction videos; sustained interest in competition-level hobby content.
topics.gap_note: High engagement with pro painter spotlights but limited step-by-step technique breakdowns—opportunity for cinematic painting tutorials featuring Golden Demon winners showing specific techniques (glazing, blending, OSL) with close-up visuals.

topics.title: The Big Autumn Q&A - Official FAQ Answers & Rule Clarifications
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official Warhammer Q&A session addressing community rules questions and clarifications for current codices.
topics.relevance_note: Direct from Warhammer; answers recurring player confusion and competitive rule disputes.

topics.title: Necromunda vs Kill Team - Comparison & Which Skirmish Game to Play
topics.what_is_driving_it: Players comparing two skirmish-scale games, asking which offers better value and gameplay experience.
topics.relevance_note: CritsNCoffee covering both games; recurring question in community about competitive positioning and learning curve.
topics.gap_note: High confusion about which game suits different players—opportunity for cinematic comparison video explaining mechanics, progression, campaign systems, and ideal audience for each.
